title: Choose the visual world for AquaSense
question: The roll assigned Hydrographic Chart. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Hydrographic Chart
options.lineage: Coastal navigation charts: depth bands, soundings, magenta notes
options.thesis: Every reading sits on a chart: the safe range is shaded water, the trust state is a printed note beside it.
options.viewport: Ink-navy side rail; a sensor strip of five readings each with its trust note; charts with the guidance range drawn as a shaded depth band and dashed contour edges.
options.risk: Magenta notes could compete with red alerts if not reserved strictly for data-trust annotations.

raised.raise: A single 'next action' line heads the overview and collapses to one decision on phones.
Sensor tiles reflow in whole cells with fixed furniture: name, value, trust note, last seen, always in the same place.
Every rule is a 1px hairline; state is a printed mark, not a coloured pill.
A tight type scale: rank comes from weight and case, not size jumps.

options.label: Test-Kit Comparator
options.lineage: Aquarium test-kit colour cards farmers read by eye
options.thesis: Each reading lands on a graded colour ladder, the way a farmer matches a vial to the kit card.
options.viewport: Top bar with tank selector; each parameter row is a horizontal swatch ladder with a marker at the current value.
options.risk: Familiar data-viz move; colour-only ladders need careful labelling for colour-blind users.

options.label: Terminal Wayfinding
options.thesis: The overview is a sign band: one yellow line saying what to do next, everything else quiet.
options.viewport: A sticky yellow band with the next action; below it plain black-on-white readings.
options.case: Wins on clarity for phones at the pond; loses on audience identification.
options.risk: Yellow reserved for wayfinding clashes with amber warning states.

options.label: Character Goods Catalog
options.thesis: Sensors as a roster of characters.
options.viewport: A pastel grid of sensor characters.
options.case: Trivialises water-safety data; farmers don't read their tank as a cast.
options.kept: Whole-cell reflow with fixed furniture per sensor.

options.label: Centre-Rail Reference
options.thesis: Readings set as an annotated edition.
options.viewport: Two text columns around a rail of keys.
options.case: A book page, not a monitoring console.
options.risk: Unreadable on a phone in sunlight.
options.kept: 1px hairlines and states as printed marks.

options.label: Timetable Slide Rack
options.thesis: One type size, raked glass slides.
options.viewport: Raked slides across a lit bed.
options.case: Raked containers fight scanability of live numbers.
options.kept: Tight type scale; rank by weight and case.

options.label: Metro Tiles
options.thesis: Giant lowercase type and flat tiles.
options.case: Dated interface costume; poor outdoor contrast.
options.kept: Chrome deleted where the type can do the job.

options.label: Variable Font Specimen
options.kept: Generous negative space around the one number that matters.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean SaaS monitoring dashboard executed at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Sidebar, KPI row, chart grid, alert list.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other IoT dashboard by design.
